stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent 2.9.3 beta hardens manual application confirmation: navigation to an unrelated page can no longer be mistaken for a successful submission. Confirmations require success text or a recognized thank-you URL, including Czech Jobs.cz odpoved-odeslana. When no cover-letter field exists, the agent now warns explicitly before manual final Submit and points to the saved draft for optional copying. Adds automatic offline PR testing; 38 regression tests passed in GitHub Actions. Final employer Submit remains manual.
